caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden object mounted on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The object appears to be a narrow wooden panel or board, fully vertical, with visible wood grain texture in shades of brown. The ledge and the panel share the same brown wood coloration and grain pattern. The area encompassing the wooden object and ledge is defined by a faint pencil line, marking out a large square in the center of the image. The overall composition is minimal, with the wooden object centrally placed and surrounded by ample empty space on all sides of the off-white background.
title: Shaker Clock Hanger
